items.source: Should not return the same instance of the ClassLoader returned from an invocation of getInstrumentableClassLoader().
items.translation: 不应返回从getInstrumentableClassLoader()调用中返回的ClassLoader的同一实例。

items.source: May be the current ClassLoader, or a ClassLoader created by this LoadTimeWeaver instance.
items.translation: 可能是当前的 `ClassLoader`，或由该 `LoadTimeWeaver` 实例创建的 `ClassLoader`。

items.source: Implementations may operate on the current context ClassLoader or expose their own instrumentable ClassLoader.
items.translation: 实现可能操作当前上下文 `ClassLoader` 或暴露其自身的可插桩 `ClassLoader`。

items.source: Add a ClassFileTransformer to be applied by this LoadTimeWeaver.
Return a ClassLoader that supports instrumentation through AspectJ-style load-time weaving based on user-defined ClassFileTransformers.
items.translation: 返回一个支持基于用户定义的ClassFileTransformers进行 AspectJ 风格加载时织入的ClassLoader。

items.source: Return a throwaway ClassLoader, enabling classes to be loaded and inspected without affecting the parent ClassLoader.
items.translation: 返回一个临时的 ClassLoader，使类能够在不影响父级 ClassLoader 的情况下被加载和检查。

items.source: the ClassLoader which will expose instrumented classes according to the registered transformers
items.translation: 将按注册的转换器暴露已增强类的ClassLoader

items.source: a temporary throwaway ClassLoader; should return a new instance for each call, with no existing state
items.translation: 一个临时的、一次性使用的 ClassLoader；每次调用都应返回一个新实例，且不带有任何现有状态。
